from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(f"- {line}", font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (6x6 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section6Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Define content
        title = "Summary and Real-World Application"
        lines = [
            "Matrices describe how we manipulate space and shapes.",
            "This math powers video game graphics and photo filters.",
            "Linear transformations bring the digital world to life."
        ]
        
        # Setup layout
        self.setup_layout(title, lines)
        
        # Colors
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_1 = "#FFFF00"  # Yellow
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_2 = "#00FFFF"  # Cyan
        GOLD_COLOR = "#FFD700"        # Gold

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Highlight first line
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_1))

        # Create "Pixel the Cat" placeholder
        # Using a stylized square with ears to represent the cat asset
        pixel_cat = VGroup(
            RoundedRectangle(corner_radius=0.2, height=1.5, width=1.5, color=WHITE),
            Triangle(color=WHITE).scale(0.2).move_to([-0.5, 0.75, 0]), # Left ear
            Triangle(color=WHITE).scale(0.2).move_to([0.5, 0.75, 0]),  # Right ear
            Text("Pixel", font_size=16)
        )
        self.place_in_area(pixel_cat, "B2", "D4", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Rotation Matrix
        # cos(45) approx 0.71
        rot_matrix = Matrix([[0.71, -0.71], [0.71, 0.71]], 
                            left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_1)
        self.place_in_area(rot_matrix, "E2", "E4", scale_factor=0.8)

        self.play(FadeIn(pixel_cat), Write(rot_matrix))
        self.play(pixel_cat.animate.rotate(45 * DEGREES), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Update lecture highlight
        self.play(
            self.lecture[0].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_2)
        )

        # Scaling Matrix
        scale_matrix = Matrix([[1.5, 0], [0, 1.0]], 
                             left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR_1)
        self.place_in_area(scale_matrix, "E2", "E4", scale_factor=0.8)

        # Morph rotation matrix into scaling matrix
        self.play(Transform(rot_matrix, scale_matrix))
        
        # Stretch Pixel horizontally
        self.play(pixel_cat.animate.scale(np.array([1.5, 0.8, 1])), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Update lecture highlight
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(WHITE),
            self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(GOLD_COLOR)
        )

        # Fade out visual aids
        self.play(FadeOut(pixel_cat), FadeOut(rot_matrix))

        # Big summary text in center
        final_text = Text("Linear Transformations", color=GOLD_COLOR, font_size=40)
        self.place_in_area(final_text, "B2", "E5", scale_factor=1.2)

        self.play(Write(final_text))
        self.wait(2)

        # Final cleanup for outro
        self.play(FadeOut(self.title), FadeOut(self.lecture), FadeOut(final_text))
        self.wait(1)

class Section5Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Setup colors
        COLOR_L1 = "#8ECAE6" # Light Blue
        COLOR_L2 = "#219EBC" # Blue
        COLOR_L3 = "#FFB703" # Gold
        COLOR_L4 = "#FB8500" # Orange
        COLOR_L5 = "#E63946" # Red

        # Setup layout
        self.setup_layout(
            "The Calculation: Transforming Pixel", 
            [
                "Matrix multiplication is a recipe for transforming any point.", 
                "Take Pixel’s coordinates as weights for the new bases.", 
                "Scale the new i-hat by his original x-coordinate.", 
                "Add the new j-hat scaled by his original y-coordinate.", 
                "His nose lands precisely at its new calculated location."
            ]
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.lecture[0].set_color(COLOR_L1)
        
        # Create Matrix equation elements
        # M * v = [2 -1; 1 1] * [1; 1]
        mat_m = Matrix([[2, -1], [1, 1]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(WHITE)
        vec_v = Matrix([[1], [1]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(COLOR_L3)
        equals = MathTex("=")
        result_template = Matrix([["?"], ["?"]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]")
        
        eq_group = VGroup(mat_m, vec_v, equals, result_template).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.2)
        self.place_in_area(eq_group, "A1", "C6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        self.play(FadeIn(eq_group))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.lecture[1].set_color(COLOR_L2)
        
        # Breakdown: 1 * [2; 1] + 1 * [-1; 1]
        weight_x = MathTex("1", color=COLOR_L3).scale(0.8)
        col_i = Matrix([[2], [1]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(COLOR_L3).scale(0.8)
        plus = MathTex("+").scale(0.8)
        weight_y = MathTex("1", color=COLOR_L4).scale(0.8)
        col_j = Matrix([[-1], [1]], left_bracket="[", right_bracket="]").set_color(COLOR_L4).scale(0.8)
        
        breakdown = VGroup(weight_x, col_i, plus, weight_y, col_j).arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.15)
        self.place_in_area(breakdown, "C1", "C6", scale_factor=1.0)
        
        # Highlight original components in matrix and vector
        box_v_x = SurroundingRectangle(vec_v.get_entries()[0], color=COLOR_L3, buff=0.05)
        box_v_y = SurroundingRectangle(vec_v.get_entries()[1], color=COLOR_L4, buff=0.05)
        box_m_i = SurroundingRectangle(mat_m.get_columns()[0], color=COLOR_L3, buff=0.05)
        box_m_j = SurroundingRectangle(mat_m.get_columns()[1], color=COLOR_L4, buff=0.05)

        self.play(Create(box_v_x), Create(box_m_i))
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(VGroup(vec_v.get_entries()[0], mat_m.get_columns()[0]), VGroup(weight_x, col_i)))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(box_v_y), Create(box_m_j))
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(VGroup(vec_v.get_entries()[1], mat_m.get_columns()[1]), VGroup(weight_y, col_j, plus)))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.lecture[2].set_color(COLOR_L3)
        
        # Visual Grid/Axes for vector addition
        plane = NumberPlane(
            x_range=[-2, 4, 1], y_range=[-1, 3, 1], 
            background_line_style={"stroke_opacity": 0.4},
            axis_config={"stroke_width": 2}
        ).scale(0.5)
        self.place_in_area(plane, "D1", "F6", scale_factor=0.8)
        
        vec_i_new = Arrow(plane.c2p(0,0), plane.c2p(2,1), buff=0, color=COLOR_L3)
        label_i = MathTex("1 \\cdot \\hat{i}_{new}", color=COLOR_L3, font_size=20)
        label_i.next_to(vec_i_new, DOWN, buff=0.1)

        self.play(FadeIn(plane))
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_i_new), Write(label_i))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.lecture[3].set_color(COLOR_L4)
        
        # New j-hat added to the tip of scaled i-hat
        vec_j_new = Arrow(plane.c2p(2, 1), plane.c2p(1, 2), buff=0, color=COLOR_L4)
        label_j = MathTex("1 \\cdot \\hat{j}_{new}", color=COLOR_L4, font_size=20)
        label_j.next_to(vec_j_new, UP, buff=0.1)
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(vec_j_new), Write(label_j))
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.lecture[4].set_color(COLOR_L5)
        
        # Resultant vector [1, 2]
        res_vec = Arrow(plane.c2p(0, 0), plane.c2p(1, 2), buff=0, color=COLOR_L5)
        nose_dot = Dot(plane.c2p(1, 2), color=COLOR_L5)
